column1: # STATUS values: removed, deprecated, changed, added, warning

column4: Ruby 3.0: Automatic Hash-to-keyword conversion removed. foo(key: val) required instead of foo({key: val})
Ruby 3.0: Last argument as keyword params no longer automatic. Use **hash explicitly
Ruby 3.2: taint/untaint/tainted? are no-ops in 3.1, removed in 3.2
Ruby 3.2 — bare alias; typically called as @x.taint

column1: # NOTE: bare `trust` / `trusted?` deliberately omitted — too common as English
# words in comments and as legitimate business-logic methods (e.g. user.trusted?).
# Qualified Object#trust / Object#trusted? still match if called explicitly.

column4: Ruby 3.0: $SAFE is now always 0, assignment raises
Ruby 3.0: open-uri no longer overrides Kernel#open. Use URI.open explicitly
Ruby 3.0: proc.call(&block) warns → use proc.call with block literal
Ruby 3.1: yields 2 args consistently (was inconsistent with lambda)
Ruby 3.2: keyword_init: nil is the default (accepts both)
Ruby 3.2: Set is now a built-in class (no require 'set')
New in Ruby 3.2: global Regexp timeout
New in Ruby 3.2: immutable value objects
